categories.core: work a paying client would buy
categories.peripheral: useful but not billable on its own

elevation_rule: If any workflow is scored toy, or two or more are peripheral, the system elevates for human review and blocks final disposition until a human records a Continue or Reject decision.

workflows.rationale: Pre-apply review of a Terraform plan for destructive changes, security exposure and cost impact is a recurring, billable cloud governance engagement (change-risk review before production applies).
Security review of Kubernetes manifests (RBAC, network policy, pod security) is standard paid platform-security work.
Least-privilege IAM policy audit is a common billable security assessment deliverable.
Writing up the review is required for delivery but a client would not buy report synthesis on its own; it exists to package the three core workflows.
